description: An SLI is a carefully defined quantitative measure of some aspect of the level of service provided. An SLO is a target value or range of values for a service level measured by an SLI: SLI ≤ target, or lower bound ≤ SLI ≤ upper bound.

sli.description: The service level indicator the SLO is measured by.

title: SRE service level objective
